title: B8 clean-checkout trivia run
description: A single documentation-only trivia packet used as the first end-to-end runtime proof of the rebuilt Builder pipeline. It makes a bounded, non-code documentation change so the queue -> worker -> validation -> review lane can be exercised without touching product behavior.

packets.title: Record the clean-checkout trivia note
packets.objective: Documentation-only. Append one short, factual trivia note to docs/mission/evidence.md recording that the rebuilt Builder pipeline was exercised end-to-end with a documentation-only trivia packet during the B8 clean-checkout mission, without any code mutation.
acceptance_criteria: docs/mission/evidence.md contains a signed section noting the B8 trivia packet ran end-to-end
The note states no product code was mutated
The note records the run's terminal classification honestly
validation_commands: grep -qi 'B8.*clean-checkout trivia' docs/mission/evidence.md && grep -qi 'no product code was mutated' docs/mission/evidence.md
